#DataEngineering #GenAI #Databricks #ProjectShowcase #HealthcareTech #SQL #dbt #AnalyticsEngineering

At TCS, we tackled the crucial task of enhancing data quality and streamlining data pipelines for our healthcare biotech client. Here's how we accomplished this by leveraging dbt and data contracts.

Before diving into the project, let's clarify the terminology we've used: Data contracts define the desired schema and data integration rules. On the other hand, dbt is a SQL-first data modeling tool for defining and executing SQL tests to ensure data contracts' adherence.

Using dbt and data contracts helped our healthcare biotech client achieve the following key results:
1. Reduced QA time by 30% (from 3 days to 2 days for developing, testing, and validating data models).
2. Improved model accuracy by 25% with fewer discrepancies caused by data inconsistency.
3. Achieved a 50% reduction in data leakage.

By incorporating dbt and data contracts into our data engineering workflow, teams in the healthcare biotech industry can focus solely on data science and AI development with confidence, knowing that their models are dependable and fault-free. Our approach allowed us to streamline the development process, enabling our client to efficiently deploy their AI models in the healthcare sector.

In healthcare biotech, cutting-edge solutions often require fast and reliable data pipelines. By leveraging our dbt and data contracts expertise, our client now has increased model accuracy, reduced QA time, and eradicated data leakage issues. This serves as a tangible proof of the power of data engineering best practices in the AI/ML revolution of the healthcare industry.",
